faq.metaDescription: Frequently asked questions about websites, apps, and digital services at TRIADA GROUP.
faq.title: Frequently asked
faq.lead: Answers about our services, timelines, and how we work.
faq.noAnswer: Didn’t find an answer? Write to us — we’ll reply personally.

items.a: We build websites and web apps, iOS/Android apps, Telegram and WhatsApp bots, CRM systems, e-commerce, plus UI/UX design and full-cycle IT products. See Services for details and indicative pricing.

Cost depends on scope: number of pages or screens, design complexity, integrations (payments, CRM, 1C, etc.), and timeline. After a briefing we send a proposal with a fixed or staged estimate. Price ranges are listed on each service page.

Timelines depend on the type of project: a landing page from 2–3 weeks, a corporate site 1–3 months, an online store or app from 2–4 months. Exact dates are set after requirements analysis and agreed in the contract.

items.q: Do you work with clients in other cities and countries?
items.a: Yes. We work remotely with clients in Kazakhstan, Russia, the CIS, and other countries. We communicate via video calls, Telegram, and email. Invoicing for legal entities is available.

items.q: Do you provide support after launch?
items.a: Yes. After delivery we can sign a support agreement: updates, monitoring, and consulting. Terms and pricing are discussed individually.
Submit the form on the site, message us on WhatsApp (+7 705 240 18 48) or email triada.workspace@gmail.com. We’ll follow up, clarify the brief, and propose a call or a commercial offer.

privacy: This Privacy Policy describes how TRIADA GROUP (“we”, “the company”) processes and protects personal data of website users and clients.

When you contact us via the form, email, messengers, or phone we may receive: name, email, phone number, company name, and message content. Technical data: IP address, browser type, cookies — for site operation and analytics.
We use data to contact you, prepare proposals, perform contracts, and improve the site and services. We do not share your personal data with third parties for marketing without your consent.
We store personal data for as long as needed to provide services and comply with the law. We apply organisational and technical measures against unauthorised access.
You may request access to, correction, or deletion of your data. Send a request to triada.workspace@gmail.com.
We may update this Privacy Policy. The current version is always available here. Continued use of the site after changes means you accept the updated policy.
terms: These Terms of Use govern the use of the TRIADA GROUP website and services (“the company”, “we”). By using the site and submitting requests you agree to these terms.

The site and all materials on it are intended to inform you about our services. Copying, distribution, or use of site materials without written consent is prohibited, except for personal non-commercial viewing.
Submitting a request does not create an obligation to enter into a contract. We contact you to clarify the brief and send a proposal. Final terms are set in the contract.
All rights to design, texts, logos, and other site materials belong to TRIADA GROUP or named rights holders. Work results for clients are transferred as specified in the contract.

The site is provided “as is”. We are not liable for temporary unavailability, failures beyond our control, or user actions outside our site. To the maximum extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amount of the contract for the specific project.
These terms and the parties’ relations are governed by the law of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Disputes are resolved by negotiation; if not settled — in court at the company’s location.
